column1: # The pack's resource table (packsched, 2026-10-09): one row per [group('solo')]/[group('solo-real')] recipe —
# tools/gate-batch.sh's lane X packs those, and a recipe with no row is a named error there: a recipe that runs in the
# pack declares its bytes. A row for a recipe the justfile does not hold is ignored; a row for one that holds neither
# group is a named error (the table serves the pack alone).
# flags: m — a clause measures the host (page-fault pins, or a plan-time room read its clauses' premises follow): the
#        item starts with nothing else running and nothing starts beside it.
# bytes: the plan's HostNeed — the bytes the engine's own load check (crates/gpu/src/model.rs, host_available) reserves
#        — plus a locked or anonymous pool the recipe sets beside it; the real tier's number. The fixture tier's loads
#        are the tree's small fixture files and reserve nothing: the pack reads 0 bytes there.
# Derivations (loadchain's D5 N2, from train028b's logs; [derived] where rounded):
#   deepseek41 --place gate: CPU 239,830,005,760 B + ROW_CACHE 4 GiB − OS reserve 6,694,629,376 B ≈ 237.6e9 [derived]
#   glm5next   --place gate: need=173,015,891,968 B (the glm5next serve log's cache line)
#   qwen4exp   --place gate: need=92,054,154,240 B (the qwen38 serve log's cache line); the serve/residency seats add
#              the churn pool 35.6e9 B beside it; iqleg loads the file twice (both resident): 2 x.
#   mimo2      --place gate: every routed expert on the host — host routed 160,859,947,008 B (mimo2_meta's pin) + the
#              host embedding 664,010,752 B, rounded up to 161.6e9 [derived]; the serve gate loads twice, one after the
#   solar2     --place gate (the 3090's 24 GiB = 25.77e9 B): Q4_K_M 151.81e9 B less the card's share — non-routed 5.08e9 B (embedding
#              0.45e9 B stays on the host), KV and scratch 5e9 B, so 25.77e9 − 4.63e9 − 5e9 = 16.1e9 B of routed experts — is
#              146.28e9 − 16.1e9 = 130.2e9 B routed on the host, plus the embedding 0.45e9 B, rounded up to 131e9 [derived]; read
#              the plan line of the first run and replace it.
#   solar2     --place bp under gate_solar2_twocard's 16 GiB card budget: host routed 122,361,937,920 B (the gate's plan line, 12,657
#              experts) plus the embedding 0.45e9 B, 122.81e9, rounded up to 123e9 [derived]; its two loads run one after the other.
#   minimaxm3  --place gate: the plan line of `gate_minimaxm3_e2e --plan` at ctx 8192 (the 3090's usable bytes; 333 of the 7,296 routed
#              experts on the card): routed experts on the host 185.34e9 B (6,963 experts) plus the token embedding 1.31e9 B that
#              stays on the host, 186.65e9 B, rounded up to 187e9 [derived from the plan's own host terms]. The serve gate
#              opens the same file at the same plan, so it holds the same bytes.
#              The prefill gate opens the same gate plan at ctx 25: a smaller cache leaves the card at least as many experts,
#              so the e2e's 187e9 bounds its host bytes [derived].
#   qwen3moe-twocard: unmeasured ceiling, the qwen38-twocard row's figure (qwen4exp --place gate need, 92,054,154,240 B).
#              The two loads run one after the other. Not a measurement of the Qwen3-30B or Qwen3.6 plan.
#   flint-twocard: [derived] pinned GGUF, 1024 context, one sequence, residency/R8 off:
#              HostNeed with every routed file tensor on the host is 24,168,079,360 B;
#              four histories of 75 * (49 * 2048 + 150144) f32 bound retained readbacks and temporaries,
#              300,595,200 B. Sequential model loads: total ceiling 24,468,674,560 B, not measured RSS.
# The fixture-only serve-start gates (gate-gpu-serve-start-*) never run in the real tier, so their row is the fixture's own host set, not
# the real file's HostNeed: glm5next fixture about 8.6e9 B, deepseek41 fixture about 15e9 B (the fixture generators' size notes, model
# crate fixture/glm5next and fixture/deepseek41 shard-size comments), one server at a time.
